product_metadata.title: EcoHome 8x10 Picture Frame Ornate Antique Gold - Mount Desktop Display, Frames
features: Picture Frame ready to Mount on the wall or Easel back to display on desktop.
Sturdy picture frame to decorate a wall, Vertically and Horizontally.
Made of recycled PS and glass. No trees were cut producing our frames.
All Ecohome Frames are carefully packaged in a tray box and bubble wrap.
Picture size opening 8x10. Total frame size with molding 10x12 (Free mat 8x10 to 5x7 included!)

details.Warranty Description: If you experience a manufacturing defect, Ecohome warrants your frames for the lifetime of the product, and we will replace the product at no charge.
